name: Studio Museum in Harlem Artist-in-Residence Program

eligibility.eligibility_notes: Official FAQ: designed to serve emerging artists of African and/or Afro-Latinx descent working locally, nationally or internationally. International applicants are accepted, so the barrier is descent, not nationality. Individuals only. The museum cannot provide visas or sponsor international applicants.

funding.stipend_detail: USD 50,000 per artist, paid biweekly over the year (official FAQ, 2026-27 cycle).

discipline.thematic_constraint: No theme. Artists across all mediums encouraged.

deadline_notes: Closed. The 2026-27 call opened 13 Apr 2026. A deadline of 18 May 2026 appears only in unverified search summaries. Next cycle not announced.
money_summary: USD 50,000 over 11 months, no housing, no visa sponsorship
notes: Artistically open, 3 artists per cycle. Blocked by the descent focus, and even if eligible there is no housing or visa sponsorship.
curation_note: Condensed 2026-09-10 from the Americas research agent output.

name: Banff Centre Early Career Banff Artist in Residence (BAiR Early Career)

eligibility.eligibility_notes: Post-secondary visual arts training or equivalent, averaging up to five years of professional practice. Individuals or duos. International applicants welcome. Participants handle their own Canadian visitor visa.

funding.stipend_detail: None. 2026 edition fee CAD 8,831.75, standard scholarship CAD 6,235.00, participant pays CAD 2,596.75.

deadline_notes: Past cycle only (2026 edition, via Akimbo). No 2027 Early Career edition listed as of 2026-09-10.
money_summary: No stipend. Artist pays about CAD 2,662 after scholarship and fee
notes: Good artistic fit with a 24/7 studio and mentorship, but fails the stipend requirement. Other open Banff visual arts programmes use the same fee-paying model.
curation_note: Condensed 2026-09-10 from the Americas research agent output.

name: 25AV Residency Programme (2026-2027)

eligibility.eligibility_notes: Duo or group of up to 4 artists based in at least 2 Creative Europe eligible countries. India is not a Creative Europe country. Within 10 years of professional practice.

funding.stipend_detail: Artist fees up to EUR 2,500 per artist plus daily subsistence support.

discipline.thematic_constraint: Collaborative audiovisual and performance work that must be stageable: media art, sound, experimental music, performance, new media.

deadline_notes: Closed. Selection announced 3 Mar 2026. No newer call found.
duration: 7 to 14 days per host plus an April 2027 festival
money_summary: Up to EUR 2,500 artist fees plus subsistence
notes: Poor fit on every count: team of 2 to 4 in Creative Europe countries, stageable audiovisual output, and closed.
curation_note: Condensed 2026-09-10 from the Americas research agent output.
